{'text': '全新 Apple TV 4K 將於明日喺 Apple「Welcome home」活動上亮相，以下係佢傳聞中嘅五項升級。', 'paragraph_context': 'A new Apple TV 4K will be unveiled tomorrow as part of Apple’s ‘Welcome home’ event. Here are five upgrades it’s rumored to bring.'}

{'text': '以下係全新 Apple TV 4K 傳聞中嘅所有升級', 'paragraph_context': 'A new Apple TV 4K will be unveiled tomorrow as part of Apple’s ‘Welcome home’ event. Here are five upgrades it’s rumored to bring.'}

{'text': 'Apple 將於本周二（10 月 13 日）舉行「Welcome home」活動，屆時將會公布多款期待已久嘅 Home 系列產品。', 'paragraph_context': 'Here’s every rumored upgrade the new Apple TV 4K will bring'}

{'text': '其中之一就係全新 Apple TV 4K，係自 2022 年以來對呢部裝置嘅首次更新。', 'paragraph_context': 'This Tuesday, October 13 Apple is holding its ‘Welcome home’ event where it will unveil several long-awaited Home products.'}

{'text': '以下係據報將會加入嘅五項新功能：', 'paragraph_context': 'One of those is a new Apple TV 4K, the first update to the device since 2022.'}

  • {'text': 'A19 晶片，較現有嘅 A15 Bionic 有所提升', 'paragraph_context': 'Here are five new features reportedly coming:'}
  • {'text': 'Siri AI', 'paragraph_context': 'A19 chip, up from the current A15 Bionic'}
  • {'text': 'Apple TV 機身內置收音咪，用於 Siri', 'paragraph_context': 'Siri AI'}
  • {'text': '配備內置喇叭嘅新版 Siri Remote', 'paragraph_context': 'Microphone built into Apple TV box for Siri'}
  • {'text': 'N1 無線晶片', 'paragraph_context': 'Updated Siri Remote with built-in speaker'}

{'text': 'A19 晶片應該會令 Apple TV 4K 運作比現有硬件更順暢，相比 2022 年型號所用嘅 A15 亦會有顯著提升。更重要的是，佢亦將支援 Siri AI。', 'paragraph_context': 'N1 wireless chip'}

{'text': '從以上功能清單可見，Siri AI 係全新 Apple TV 嘅核心重點。', 'paragraph_context': 'The A19 chip should make the Apple TV 4K run smoother than current hardware, and offer a significant upgrade over the A15 in the 2022 model. It will importantly also add support for Siri AI.'}

{'text': 'Siri 唔單止會有軟件上嘅改進，憑藉 Apple TV 4K 機身內置嘅收音咪，用戶同 Siri 互動將會更加方便。', 'paragraph_context': 'As is clear from the list of features above, Siri AI is a central focus of the new Apple TV.'}

{'text': '類似 HomePod 嘅做法，用戶可以純粹用語音同 Siri 互動，毋須再撳 Siri Remote 上嘅按鈕。我估甚至可以叫 Siri 幫你搵遙控器，佢會喺新版 Siri Remote 發出聲響，等你搵到佢放咗喺邊。', 'paragraph_context': 'Siri won’t merely get a software improvement. It will also be easier to interact with thanks to the built-in microphone in the Apple TV 4K box.'}

{'text': 'N1 無線晶片預計可以提升 AirDrop 等功能嘅穩定性，並可能會同其他 Apple Home 相關功能嘅改進互相配合。', 'paragraph_context': 'Similar to a HomePod, this will enable interacting with Siri entirely by voice, with no need to hit the button on the Siri Remote. I suspect you’ll even be able to ask Siri to find the remote, and it will play a noise on the new Siri Remote so you can find where you left it.'}

{'text': '除咗呢五項升級之外，Apple 隨時可能會為我哋帶來尚未流出嘅新功能驚喜。本周所有發布消息，我哋會繼續為大家緊貼報導。', 'paragraph_context': 'The N1 wireless chip is expected to enable improved reliability with features like AirDrop, and could tie into other Apple Home-related feature improvements.'}

{'text': '你打算將手上嘅 Apple TV 4K 升級到新機嗎？歡迎喺留言區告訴我哋。', 'paragraph_context': 'Beyond these five upgrades, Apple could always surprise us with new features that haven’t yet been rumored. We’ll keep you posted on all the announcements as they unfold this week.'}
